summary: Ermenegildo Zegna N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 revenue press release. Revenues rose 2.5% YoY (7.4% organic) to €470M, driven by DTC growth of 7.8% (14.2% organic). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly update and does not constitute a special situation.
